text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Up to this point, our preparations for the race are complete.
Everything is proceeding precisely as I envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If we keep this up, I believe we can achieve great results.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However... this pounding in my chest.
This alone was completely unexpected."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I try to suppress it, as the race draws near,
it grows so strong... it makes my whole body tremble—
choice_data_list: Let's take it all out in the race!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
! ...I see. It seems that is the only way
to calm these feelings.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well then—let us go
and seize victory.
